veranderings.blok: 'n Woestyn is nie net sand nie
veranderings.voor: Mis van die see gee vog aan
veranderings.na: Mis wat van die see af kom, gee vog aan
veranderings.rede: 'Mis van die see' reads as mist belonging to the sea; stating where it comes from is clearer and more natural.

veranderings.voor: loop die grenslyn dan saam met die blou lyn
veranderings.na: val die grenslyn dan saam met die blou lyn
veranderings.rede: 'saamval met' is the idiomatic Afrikaans for two lines coinciding; 'loop saam met' suggests walking alongside.

veranderings.blok: Die Oranjerivier is net op dele 'n grens
veranderings.voor: Sy laaste deel voor die see
veranderings.na: Die rivier se laaste deel voor die see
veranderings.rede: After a sentence whose subject is 'n Kort stuk', 'Sy' is a loose reference; naming the river makes it clear.
A comma before 'en' between parts of one sentence breaks the AWS rule; 'asook' keeps the needed pause correctly.
The 'en' joins two objects of one verb, not two sentences, so no comma goes before it.

vlae.blok: woestyn (begrip) / 'n Woestyn is nie net sand nie
vlae.teks: 'n Plek waar baie min reën in 'n jaar val.
vlae.rede: The glossary definition adds 'in 'n jaar' while the study text says 'n plek waar baie min reën val'; one lesson gives two slightly different wordings of one term, which is a content decision for the writer, not a language fix.
